development: Reuse exactly the frozen SciFact development query IDs. Preserve prior selected BM25/RRF parameters as an untuned reference; new fusion controls use unchanged default sparse/dense legs and k=60. Never select or amend configurations using test judgments. Transfer unchanged to SCIDOCS.

sparse_then_dense.scoring: exact cosine on sparse candidates, no new embedding model

selection: For each fusion family maximize mean development document nDCG@10; break ties by ascending sparse weight. Record every development configuration including rejected alternatives. No product default promotion in this study.

document_controls.title_abstract: One Go BM25 document per complete BEIR title plus text record; no chunk collapse. These corpora provide abstracts, not full paper bodies.

whole_paper.reason: No matched full-text corpus. Owner approved complete BEIR records as the available document control.

document_controls.normalization_note: Experimental English controls isolate stopword/stemming effects; not a claim of byte-for-byte Elasticsearch or Lucene replication. Product analyzer unchanged.

chunk_controls.embedding_contract: Run input-only preflight for exact product chunking. If any input exceeds the pinned encoder's 256 wordpieces, report dense/hybrid unavailable for that exact configuration; never truncate or silently change chunks. Evaluate sparse for both exact product budgets.

reranker.pair: query, title plus retained passage text
reranker.pool: Freeze first 50 chunks of unchanged default legacy hybrid, before scoring; record hashes and candidate IDs. Reorder only these 50 and append the unchanged remaining candidate tail, then collapse to papers.
reranker.report: paired bootstrap versus plain hybrid; end-to-end and incremental rerank latency; no weights blended or selected on test queries

latency: One query at a time, warm loaded artifacts and models. Measure wall clock, not sum of overlapping leg durations. Alternate sequential/concurrent ordering by query index. Record leg timings and parity. Fusion and cross-encoder variants reuse the unchanged frozen candidate legs: their totals are measured shared-leg wall time plus separately measured fusion/reranking, labeled component sums rather than independent end-to-end measurements. Exclude HTTP/auth/database and model startup; report them as outside scope.
default_policy: Keep retrieval, analyzer, chunking, candidate limits, fusion parameters and reranker defaults unchanged. Concurrent scheduling may replace sequential scheduling only with exact ranking/score parity tests and measured latency evidence.
